bodySpecFinalOverrides.prompt:
Production game motion sheet, 2048x2048, EXACTLY FOUR separate full-body poses in a neat 2x2 arrangement. Genuine transparent RGBA with large empty spacing. Each cell contains ONE complete knight WITH head and weapon drawn together. Do not split the neck, paste a head, omit the sword, or make separate floating pieces. No text or labels.
Image 1 is the original approved SX knight design. Image 2 is the newly drawn horizontal-slash pilot clarifying coherent anatomy and a straight sword, not an alternative face. Image 3 shows the exact original helmet. Match this same identity and detail in all 4 poses: polished cobalt/silver armor, slim gold trim, large angular shoulder plates, long blue/black/gold cape; compact blue forehead jewel, narrow cyan eyes, smooth ivory cheek/face plate and pointed chin, swept silver/gold side crests, NO new horns behind the head. Head remains natural-sized and visibly connected to neck/collar/shoulders.
Adult original proportions, same fixed camera front-right 3/4 and consistent body scale across all cells. Avoid edge-on head/profile; face readable and identical. Different real articulated knees, pelvis, torso, shoulders and hands; flowing cape follows each action.
Greatsword: draw it as part of each complete pose with the hand gripping its long black handle, ornate gold sunburst guard and round medallion, long broad ivory/silver blade with a raised straight gold decorative spine. SINGLE STRAIGHT RIGID WEAPON from pommel through handle and guard to tip. Both blade edges are straight, nearly parallel, then symmetrically pointed at the tip. Gold filigree sits on a straight blade; no banana curve, bowed outline, angular break, thin rapier, foreshortened edge view, or floating hand. Keep its same width and length relative to the body in all 4 drawings. No head or weapon collage. Full blade, pommel, helmet, cloak and boots inside EACH cell, at least 7% empty margins, do not overlap neighboring cells. No floor, glow, effects, background, gradients or annotations. Detailed painted game sprite finish like original.
POSES in reading order:
1. Fast dash through the air, bent front knee and trailing back leg, cape stretched left, sword straight back-left, head still front-right 3/4.
2. Front foot reaches ahead for landing, rear leg folds, torso rises, sword remains straight back-left.
3. Grounded braking crouch, front foot planted, knees compress, torso rises, sword in right hand pointing back-left and downward 15 degrees.
4. Recovered ready stance, both boots grounded, right hand lowers sword diagonally down-right 40 degrees, original connected helmet.
COLOR LOCK: user approved the shown new dash/attack sheets and explicitly forbids color drift. Maintain the ORIGINAL deep cobalt blue, neutral polished silver/ivory and restrained gold trim coverage. Never shift blue to teal/purple, never increase gold surfaces or turn white armor yellow, never overexpose or boost contrast/saturation. All blue glow and afterimages will be separate layers, NOT baked into body. Input 4 is the accepted connected dash/attack sheet; it is the current continuity anchor.

takeoffRepair.prompt:
Draw ONE complete connected SX knight battle sprite in the instant of TAKEOFF, full body with full sword in transparent portrait 1024x1536. Image 1 is the exact approved design, image 2 is the accepted motion/color style. Do not detach or paste head/neck/weapon. Draw them together. Same compact helmet and face, deep cobalt blue, silver/ivory panels and restrained gold trim; do not increase gold or saturation.

Standing-body proportions MUST stay like the approved adult knight: long thighs and long shins, normal pelvis, full-length legs, not a squat/chibi body. Preserve knee/hip/ankle connections. The right knee lifts only modestly, the left leg pushes off almost straight with toe pointing down. Torso remains tall with both arms holding the sword ABOVE the head, slightly to the right so the face is fully readable. Cape trails behind-left.

The entire broad ivory/gold greatsword is VERY LONG (guard-to-tip approximately 75% of unbent head-to-sole body height), pointing perfectly straight UP vertically. Never shorten it into a dagger to fit. Gold pommel, black handle, round sunburst guard, raised gold central rib and tip form a single straight vertical axis. Parallel straight cutting edges, slight taper and pointed tip. No bent sword, no broken hilt, no duplicate handles. Full connected grip and fingers. Fit BOTH long legs and full tall sword by drawing the ENTIRE figure uniformly smaller, with 7% clear transparent margins around every outer edge. No background, no ground, no VFX, no text. High-detail same painted metallic finish.

originalTitle.prompt: A premium Korean fantasy game TITLE NAMEPLATE ORNAMENT for a cobalt blue/silver armored greatsword knight called Blue Reaper. Text will be set with native typography later, so NO LETTERS, NO TEXT, NO LOGOS. Single long narrow horizontal frame, transparent RGBA background, about 3.5:1 aspect ratio 1536x448. Wide CLEAR DARK NAVY central inset for four Korean characters, center 65% should be unobstructed. Two small symmetrical spectral blue sword motifs sweep outward on left and right, sharp polished silver edges with very fine restrained gold trim. Deep royal cobalt enamel, cool cyan edge shimmer, subtle cold-blue soul wisps around the OUTSIDE only; not giant white bloom. Elegant high-end fantasy title decoration, thin silhouette with a tiny centered blue gem at the top and small tapered blade point at the bottom. No opaque rectangle background, no card, no busy thick feathers, no large horns. Crisp readable at 280x80 pixels. Keep whole ornament and faint glow inside frame with generous transparent margins.

proportionPolicy: Preserve original adult head-to-body, torso and pelvis/knee/ankle lengths in every connected drawing. Compare unlit poses to approved source; no per-pose height normalization or nonuniform scaling.
